implementation: New bounded adapter over existing real SHA1 and bitsliced AES128 providers; no copied vendor source, firmware, dynamic crypto-dispatch, or test stubs.
license: BSD-2-Clause-Patent (adapter and tests); provider retains full MIT notice in libkern/crypto/a04br3_bearssl/LICENSE.txt and source files.

source_contract_references.role: Read-only primary-source corroboration of PRF label NUL/counter0/sorted address+nonce data, fixed4096/32-byte PBKDF2, descriptor-v2 HMAC-SHA1 first16 MIC bytes. No hostap code copied.

supported: WPA2-Personal CCMP descriptor-v2 only; PTK PRF-SHA1 64 bytes for owner ABI, CCMP consumes first48; no TKIP/CMAC/PMF/WPA3/RFC5649.
integration: Header-only; existing libkern/conf/files entries a04br3_sha1/dec32be/enc32be/aes_ct/aes_ct_dec/aes_ct_cbcdec provide symbols. No new object registration. RNG and handshake state/key installation/TX completion remain caller-owned.
host_tests: Python standard hashlib/hmac (independent OpenSSL), system OpenSSL CLI AES128 wrap, actual providers under ASAN/UBSAN, ARM64 C/C++ freestanding plus arm64 iOS Mach-O adapter codegen. No Darwin SDK link/boot implied.
